claims.head: Sheltered against exposed
claims.body: On quality allowed, Buffalo sits 9th of 32, at the sheltered end of the scale. Montréal is 25th, at the exposed end.

MTL.head: Close, but Buffalo has the slight edge
MTL.body: Buffalo has controlled the play far better over recent games and Montréal has home ice. Montréal’s best way to tip it is getting to the dangerous areas.

BUF.head: Buffalo has a slight edge
BUF.body: Buffalo has controlled the play far better over recent games and Montréal has home ice. Montréal can still swing it if it gets to the dangerous areas.
